intro.narrative: One paragraph read to / displayed for the group that sets the opening scene. This is the PRIMARY thing shown to players.
intro.facilitator_notes: Guidance for the moderator only (players should not see this).
intro.company_info: Optional static background about the organization.

dm_brief.situation: Full background the DM uses to adjudicate. Describe the world, the current problem, and what is at stake.
dm_brief.stakes: What is lost if the group fails.
pressure_points: (Optional, backward-compat) An event the DM may inject if the group stalls.
Prefer the top-level 'events' array below for conditional, once-per-session events.
rules_of_play: Never propose actions or present a menu of choices; react only to what the group does.
Only metrics the scenario tracks may change; keep values between 0 and 100.

events.text: An event that fires if the group stalls for 2 turns.
An event that fires when risk crosses 60.

goal.description: What the group is trying to achieve. When ALL win_conditions are met simultaneously, the scenario ends in success.
goal.ending: Crisis resolved: trust restored. The exercise concludes.

end_conditions.ending: Risk overload: the event becomes a full enterprise incident.
Time ran out on the scheduled exercise.

report.audit_note: Generated automatically at session end or timeout.
